name: Geneweaver
subtitle: Catch them. Merge them. Weave your own.
localizedDescription:
A creature-catching battler in a sunny world of tomorrow that went sideways. Catch wildlife tangled up with retro tech, battle in blind picks where speed shows you what your rival did NOT choose, and merge creatures into new ones nobody else has.

iPhone beta: portrait, with the pad and buttons below the game screen.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Hold B to run.
- A local in every town with tips, and Dr. Hollis in Homestead.
- Grass and paths are easier to tell apart.
- At the top of a route you can leave from either lane.
- The game saves when you leave the app while in a town.
- Battles rebalanced: stats, traits and type advantage retuned from 100,000 simulated fights; no single stat or trait is the best pick.
- Levelling is twice as fast.
